description: This file defines the interface for the MediaFrameWriterV1 class, which handles writing media frames to shared memory, including metadata and data segments, within the Rialto media framework. It includes class declarations, constants, and method signatures related to media frame writing.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV1
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames, including metadata and data, to shared memory buffers in the Rialto media framework.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the writer with a shared memory buffer and associated info.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment (frame) to shared memory, including metadata and data.

methods.name: getNumFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames written so far.

methods.name: writeMetaDataGeneric
methods.description: Writes generic metadata for a media segment.

methods.name: writeMetaDataTypeSpecific
methods.description: Writes type-specific metadata for a media segment.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes the media data payload for a segment.
